extracted.summary: The AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls provides financial support to girl students admitted to the first year or second year through lateral entry in technical diploma or degree programmes, with a maximum family income of INR 8,00,000. The scholarship offers INR 50,000 per annum for up to three years for first‑year admits and two years for lateral entry students.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: The annual family income of the applicant must not exceed INR 8,00,000 during the preceding financial year.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must be girl students admitted to the 1st year, or the 2nd year through lateral entry only, of a technical diploma or degree programme.
